svg.title: Our Clean booking calls storage through a core contract
svg.desc: Web adapter creates BookVisitCommand Plain values cross into the application Outer transaction decorator invokes BookVisit The transaction covers use case and persistence adapter BookingVisit validates and calls VisitStore The core describes the storage operation it needs JpaVisitStore loads, checks, maps and saves Membership is checked against the loaded Owner Transaction commits, then return success The web adapter translates the outcome into a redirect

g.text: Our Clean booking calls storage through a core contract
Plain values cross into the application
The transaction covers use case and persistence adapter
The core describes the storage operation it needs
4. JpaVisitStore loads, checks, maps and saves
Membership is checked against the loaded Owner
The web adapter translates the outcome into a redirect
The adapter handles the call at runtime and implements an interface owned by the core.
The decorator owns the outermost transaction here. An existing outer transaction would own the commit.
